courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工
related.transfer: 可遷移「裂隙開度與流量」與「壓水試驗標準化」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fracture aperture and flow" and "Water-test normalization" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦裂隙可灌性、有效注入壓力與帷幕驗證；瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工則以瀝青心牆的溫度依存、孔隙控制與界面變形為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fracture groutability, effective injection pressure and curtain verification; Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction centres on temperature dependence, void control and interface deformation in asphalt cores, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裂隙開度與流量」與「膠結料比例基準」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到瀝青混凝土心牆壩施工，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「趾板接觸與有效壓力」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fracture aperture and flow” and “Binder proportion basis”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Asphalt-core embankment-dam construction, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Plinth contact and effective pressure", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 壩基排水廊道
related.transfer: 可遷移「裂隙開度與流量」與「壓水試驗標準化」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；壩基排水廊道的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Fracture aperture and flow" and "Water-test normalization" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Dam-foundation drainage galleries must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦裂隙可灌性、有效注入壓力與帷幕驗證；壩基排水廊道則以排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on fracture groutability, effective injection pressure and curtain verification; Dam-foundation drainage galleries centres on gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「裂隙開度與流量」與「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到壩基排水廊道，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「廊道熱量與通風尺度」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Fracture aperture and flow” and “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Dam-foundation drainage galleries, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Gallery heat and ventilation scale", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 壩基帷幕灌漿
history.text: 基礎帷幕灌漿把裂隙地質、漿液流變和水力驗證連在一起，耗漿量只是過程資料，真正的工程判斷還要追蹤空間連續與剩餘通水路徑。墾務局重力壩設計專書提供岩基處理與結構整合背景。 土石壩設計標準的基礎灌漿章節更新，官方目錄列明版本。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，整理材料、處理與驗證背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Foundation curtain grouting connects fracture geology, grout rheology and hydraulic verification. Consumption is process evidence; engineering interpretation must also track spatial continuity and remaining conductive paths. Reclamation gravity-dam guidance provides context for foundation treatment and structural integration. The foundation-grouting chapter of embankment standards is updated, as documented by the official index. USACE publishes Grouting Technology, organizing material, treatment and verification context. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.
